dream: I pressed the round urn down on the leaking stack while the card hummed warm. The leak slid, so the round stump caught it before the slip decided to move. I swapped the box for a flat stone at the wedge, trusting the lean to hold the weight. The air felt thin as a breath, making the heavy turnip look like a drawing of fruit. I pressed the tired bush down with my heavy hands, swapping a flat stump for a round one while the fence leaned wrong. I stood still by The Heavy Lid, waiting for the slip to choose whether to move or just slide into the thin air I cannot feel.
